newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Erbakan meets military chief.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Erbakan meets military chief.

text.p: Turkey's Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan began talks on Tuesday with the head of the armed forces, Ismail Hakki Karadayi, amid mounting military pressure on his coalition government.
Witnesses said Erbakan, Turkey's first Islamist leader, welcomed the military chief at the main door of the prime minister's office.

"He is coming to see me and I will hug him," Erbakan, known for his colourful rhetoric, earlier told a meeting of his Islam-based Welfare Party MPs. "The press will go crazy. I am saying this in advance so they don't have a heart attack."

The army and Erbakan's Islamist-led alliance have been at odds for the last two months over army demands for a crackdown on. A leading general said on Tuesday that the army's fight against an Islamist upsurge was a matter of life or death.
Erbakan has delayed implementing the military's anti-Islamist orders.
